page.content:
Emperor of Outworld who uses Mortal Kombat as conquest.

How Shao Kahn connects

  • Location: Outworld — Shao Kahn rules Outworld as emperor.
  • Location: Earthrealm — Shao Kahn uses the tournament — and then invasion — to take Earthrealm.
  • Character: Kitana — Kitana turned on Shao Kahn after learning he stole Edenia.
  • Location: Kahn's Koliseum — Shao Kahn stages kombat in his Outworld koliseum.

What is Shao Kahn?

Shao Kahn is the hammer-wielding emperor of Outworld. When his champions fail the tournament, he invades Earthrealm anyway and claims Kitana, Sindel, and Mileena as imperial blood.

Key threads lead to Outworld, Earthrealm, Kitana and Kahn's Koliseum.
